name: home1
js: const c=__bw.ctl, T=__bw.THREE; const camp=__bw.scene.getObjectByName('attackerCamp'); if(!camp) return {camp:false}; const bb=new T.Box3(); camp.traverse(o=>{ if(o.isMesh||o.isSprite){ const b=new T.Box3().setFromObject(o); if(isFinite(b.min.x)) bb.union(b);} }); const ct=bb.getCenter(new T.Vector3()); c.target.x=ct.x; c.target.z=ct.z; c.dist=95; return {camp:true,vis:camp.visible,c:[ct.x|0,ct.z|0],size:bb.getSize(new T.Vector3()).toArray().map(v=>v|0), kids:camp.children.length};

name: start
js: const T={levels:{keep:18,wall:18,towers:18,barracks:12,lair:12},seed:11,ratio:1.1,power:4500,loot:{turq:60,emerald:60,ruby:60},tesla:0,emblem:'swords',name:'Navid'}; __bw.battle.start(T,null,null); for(let i=0;i<1200;i++){ await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500)); if(__bw.battle.session && !__bw.battle.loading) break; } const S=__bw.battle.session; S.cam.intro=0; return {ok:!!S, camp:!!S.camp, dp:[S.sim.deploy.x|0,S.sim.deploy.z|0]};

name: camp0
js: const S=__bw.battle.session; S.hud.el.style.display='none'; const T=__bw.THREE; const dp=S.sim.deploy; const cx=dp.x+dp.nx*52+(-dp.nz)*(-24), cz=dp.z+dp.nz*52+dp.nx*(-24); S.cam.tx=cx; S.cam.tz=cz; S.cam.dist=62; S.cam.az=S.cam.az0+Math.PI*0.9; return {c:[cx|0,cz|0]};

name: giant0
js: const S=__bw.battle.session, sim=S.sim; S.__p0=S.cam.pitch; S.hud.el.style.display='none'; const g=sim.units.find(u=>u.type==='giant'); S.cam.tx=g.x; S.cam.tz=g.z; S.cam.dist=11; S.cam.az=S.cam.az0+0.9; return {g:[g.x|0,g.z|0]};

name: fight
js: const S=__bw.battle.session, sim=S.sim; S.hud.el.style.display=''; S.started=true; const keep=sim.buildings.find(b=>b.type==='keep'); for(const t of S.types){ const u=sim.units.find(x=>x.type===t); if(u&&u.air) continue; sim.send(t,keep.x,keep.z);} for(let i=0;i<420;i++){ sim.step(0.1); } const bs=sim.buildings.filter(b=>!b.dead&&b.hp<b.maxHp*0.9&&b.type!=='wall'); let best=null; for(const b of bs){ const n=sim.units.filter(u=>!u.dead&&Math.hypot(u.x-b.x,u.z-b.z)<30).length; if(!best||n>best.n) best={b,n}; } const b=best?best.b:sim.buildings[0]; S.cam.tx=b.x; S.cam.tz=b.z; S.cam.dist=48; S.cam.pitch=S.__p0; return {t:sim.time|0,dmg:bs.length,at:[b.x|0,b.z|0],n:best&&best.n};
